title.zh: 【慢雾：LiteLLM 再遭供应链攻击，恶意版本 1.107.0 窃取云凭证与 AI 密钥】
title.en: 【慢雾：LiteLLM 再遭供应链攻击，恶意版本 1.107.0 窃取云凭证与 AI 密钥】

current_state.zh: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
current_state.en: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
